verdicts.explanation: The HTLP film (Li3.08Ge0.52P0.47O4) room-temperature value of ~1.2 × 10-5 S cm-1 and Ea 0.46 eV are the paper's own extrapolated results, so experimental origin and a null measurement temperature are correct.

The LTLP amorphous film (Li2.44Ge0.72P0.41O4) extrapolated room-temperature value of ~5.2 × 10-8 S cm-1 and Ea 0.72 eV are reported in this paper from its own in situ measurements, with composition from Table 3.

The 3.8 × 10-6 S cm-1 value with Ea 0.5 eV for x = 0.66 is attributed to Song et al. (ref 29) for LGPO pellets, so literature_cited is correct; the room-temperature context is implied by the σRT comparison in the text.

The ~3 × 10-6 S cm-1 and Ea 0.51 eV thin-film values are attributed to Gilardi et al. in the text and Figure 5 caption (films at 500 °C, which the paper's own deposition conditions do not include), so literature_cited is right despite the stray 'in this study' wording.
The amorphous-film σRT ~3 × 10-7 S cm-1, Ea 0.58 eV and composition Li1.58±0.4Ge0.45P0.55O3.27±0.5 are explicitly attributed to Gilardi et al. [19], so literature_cited is correct.
